digest.component_or_area: MCP HMAC secret infrastructure (SSM / environment variables / deployment)
propositions: MCP_HMAC_SIGNING_KEY environment variable and /rebar/prod/mcp-hmac-signing-key SSM parameter are produced by Terraform and transported into deployment environment files but have zero runtime consumers in application code.

Verdict signing was superseded by ADR 0049, which replaced symmetric HMAC with asymmetric Ed25519 operation certificates; the shipped verdict-signing path uses the op-cert Ed25519 key, not the HMAC secret.

Removing the orphaned secret requires atomic deletion across six tracked files: ssm.tf, user_data.sh, fetch-secrets.sh, and three documentation files (0012-iac-foundations.md, gerrit-aws-setup.md, provision-restore.md).

Removal eliminates a misleading rotation obligation and KMS audit noise while introducing no runtime compatibility breaks, but safe rollback requires retaining the Terraform slot for one release after dropping script references.
